name: Inukai Takehiko
source:
"I've been here long enough to know better." 

A bespectacled highbrow guy. Takehiko is the only male employee at Clover Design.

He is not very good with women, and there has never been anything more than work relations between him and any of his cowokers. He seems to have a secret crush on someone, but his shyness makes it impossible for her to become aware of it.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/seabed/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
